context: Introduces an ApiError/ValidationError hierarchy with cause chaining and a parseApiResponse helper to replace scattered plain Error throws.
explanation: Both classes call super(message, { cause }) so the standard Error 'cause' option is preserved through the chain, giving stack traces and logging tools the original underlying error (like a JSON parse failure) instead of losing it. Setting this.name lets instanceof and name-based error handling keep working after minification. ValidationError correctly narrows ApiError with a fixed status/code and its own fields. Clean, idiomatic error modeling.
